_comment: The first batch, one record per customer. No contact details, no company names that are not already public, nothing a customer did not agree to show: a handle, a kind, the dates and counts the brief asks to track, the state of each milestone step, and the follow-up log as dates and three short answers. The lead holds the rest privately (a list, never committed; see docs/ops/needs.md). A record whose kind is example is a worked example of the page, not a customer. Rendered on /customers/ and one page per record by admin/build/gen_customers.py. Milestone states: open, in-progress, done (with a date).
